arxiv-2209-12968.title: Intention Communication and Hypothesis Likelihood in Game-Theoretic Motion Planning
arxiv-2209-12968.creator: Makram Chahine, Roya Firoozi, Wei Xiao, Mac Schwager, Daniela Rus
arxiv-2209-12968.description: Abstract Game-theoretic motion planners are a potent solution for controlling systems of multiple highly interactive robots. Most existing game-theoretic planners unrealistically assume a priori objective function knowledge is available to all agents. To address this, we propose a fault-tolerant receding horizon game-theoretic motion planner that leverages inter-agent communication with intention hypothesis likelihood.

arxiv-2302-07281.title: Collapsar Gamma-ray Bursts Grind their Black Hole Spins to a Halt
arxiv-2302-07281.creator: Jonatan Jacquemin-Ide, Ore Gottlieb, Beverly Lowell, Alexander Tchekhovskoy
arxiv-2302-07281.description: Abstract The spin of a newly formed black hole (BH) at the center of a massive star evolves from its natal value due to two competing processes: accretion of gas angular momentum that increases the spin, and extraction of BH angular momentum by outflows that decreases the spin.

arxiv-2307-06346.creator: Florian Sextl, Adam Rogalewicz, Tomáš Vojnar, Florian Zuleger
arxiv-2307-06346.description: Abstract . Biabduction-based shape analysis is a compositional verification and analysis technique that can prove memory safety in the presence of complex, linked data structures. Despite its usefulness, several open problems persist for this kind of analysis; two of which we address in this paper.

arxiv-2401-09144.title: Monitoring Machine Learning Forecasts for Platform Data Streams Correspondence to Ines Wilms, Maastricht University, i.wilms@maastrichtuniversity.nl. We are very grateful to Benjamin Wolter, Pablo Perez Piskunow and Roger Caminal for expert advice, to Aurore Delaigle, Geert Dhaene, David S. Matteson
arxiv-2401-09144.creator: Jeroen Rombouts, Ines Wilms
arxiv-2401-09144.description: Abstract Abstract. Data stream forecasts are essential inputs for decision making at digital platforms. Machine learning (ML) algorithms are appealing candidates to produce such forecasts. Yet, digital platforms require a large-scale forecast framework that can flexibly respond to sudden performance drops. Re-training ML algorithms at the same speed as new data batches enter is usually computationally too costly.

arxiv-2508-19040.title: NUMERICAL INTEGRATION OF STOCHASTIC DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS: THE HEUN ALGORITHM REVISITED AND THE ITÔ STRATONOVICH CALCULUS
arxiv-2508-19040.creator: Riccardo Mannella
arxiv-2508-19040.description: Abstract The widely used Heun algorithm for the numerical integration of stochastic differential equations (SDEs) is critically re-examined. We discuss and evaluate several alternative implementations, motivated by the fact that the standard Heun scheme is constructed from a low-order integrator. The convergence, stability, and equilibrium properties of these alternatives are assessed through extensive numerical simulations.

pmc-10587940.title: Survival of Filipino women with breast cancer in the United States
pmc-10587940.creator: David W. Lim, Winston W. Li, Vasily Giannakeas, Tulin D. Cil, Steven A. Narod
pmc-10587940.description: BackgroundThe survival of women with early‐stage breast cancer varies by racial group. Filipino women with breast cancer are an understudied group and are often combined with other Asian groups. We compared clinical presentations and survival rates for Filipino and White women with breast cancer diagnosed in the United States.

pmc-10614512.title: Transcription Factor Sox9 Exacerbates Kidney Injury through Inhibition of MicroRNA-96-5p and Activation of the Trib3/IL-6 Axis
pmc-10614512.creator: Xiao Wang, Guang Chen, Yongqiang Du, Jiajia Yang, Wei Wang
pmc-10614512.description: IntroductionOur study investigated the possible mechanisms of the role of the transcription factor Sox9 in the development and progression of kidney injury through regulation of the miR-96-5p/Trib3/IL-6 axis.MethodsBioinformatics analysis was performed to identify differentially expressed genes in kidney injury and normal tissues.

pmc-10752755.title: Top Alzheimer's disease risk allele frequencies differ in HABS‐HD Mexican‐ versus Non‐Hispanic White Americans
pmc-10752755.creator: Mohammad Housini, Zhengyang Zhou, John Gutierrez, Sumedha Rao, Rodwan Jomaa, Kumudu Subasinghe, Danielle Marie Reid, Talisa Silzer, Nicole Phillips, Sid O'Bryant, Robert Clinton Barber, For the HABS‐HD Study Team
pmc-10752755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). INTRODUCTION: Here we evaluate frequencies of the top 10 Alzheimer's disease (AD) risk alleles for late‐onset AD in Mexican American (MA) and non‐Hispanic White (NHW) American participants enrolled in the Health and Aging Brain Study–Health Disparities Study cohort. METHODS: Using DNA extracted from this community‐based diverse population, we calculated the genotype frequencies in each population to determine whether a significant difference is detected between the different ethnicities. DNA genotyping was performed per manufacturers’ protocols.

pmc-11586555.title: Exposure to respirable silica contributes to lower airway inflammation in asthmatic horses
pmc-11586555.creator: Alessandra Romolo, Giulia Costa, Beatrice Sica, Giulia Memoli, Matteo Ardit, Francesco Di Benedetto, Donata Bellis, Silvana Capella, Elena Belluso, Michela Bullone
pmc-11586555.description: BackgroundRespirable mineral particles can induce lower airway inflammation, but the role they play in asthma of horses is unknown.ObjectivesRespirable mineral particles, particularly respirable silica, are an overlooked determinant of chronic lung inflammation (asthma) in horses.AnimalsTwenty‐three horses from an equine hospital population: 11 moderately affected (MEA), 7 severely asthmatic (SEA), and 5 control horses free from respiratory clinical signs.MethodsProspective observational study.

pmc-12504433.title: Self-powered near-infrared mechanoluminescence through MgO/MgF2 piezo-photonic heterojunctions
pmc-12504433.creator: Sheng Wu, Shunyu Wang, Zhigang Shao, Yinzhen Wang, Puxian Xiong
pmc-12504433.description: Near-infrared mechanoluminescent (NIR ML) materials attract considerable attention for their force-to-light conversion capabilities. However, current materials generally have disadvantages such as high threshold and poor self-recovery ability, which limit their practical applications. Herein, we present a self-powered NIR ML material MgF2:Cr3+, which does not require pre-charging process.

pmc-12585588.title: Lessons Learned Implementing a Protein Crystallography CURE
pmc-12585588.creator: Krystle J McLaughlin
pmc-12585588.description: Course-based Undergraduate Research Experiences (CUREs) are a pedagogical approach that integrates research into the curriculum. Instead of students working through traditional teaching lab experiments with known outcomes, in a CURE students investigate an authentic research question while still learning essential lab skills.

pmc-13100032.title: Managing salinity stress through microclimate control to enhance tomato productivity in arid regions
pmc-13100032.creator: Farhat Abbas, Salem Al-Naemi
pmc-13100032.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Given the increasing reliance on saline groundwater in arid regions, it is essential to assess how interacting abiotic stresses affect tomato growth, physiological performance, and productivity under different production environments. This study aimed to evaluate selected abiotic factors (including light, temperature, humidity, and irrigation water salinity), typical of Middle Eastern groundwater, that interact to influence morpho-physiological traits and yield of tomato grown under greenhouse, net house, and open field systems.
